tools.name: view_skill
tools.description: Load a skill's SKILL.md, absolute skill root, and relative linked-file listing. With relative_path, reads that file (Skill root / File headers; no listing).

parameters.name: relative_path
parameters.description: Optional relative path within the skill to read (e.g. 'references/api.md'). Omit to get SKILL.md plus the linked-files listing.

tools.name: create_skill
tools.description: Create a new skill directory with SKILL.md only (YAML frontmatter + markdown instructions). Errors if the skill already exists.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Skill name: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only (e.g. 'code-review'). Becomes the folder name.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: What the skill does and when to use it (third person). Truncated to 1024 characters.

parameters.name: instructions
parameters.description: Markdown body of SKILL.md (procedure, when to load supporting files, examples).

tools.name: edit_skill
tools.description: Update an existing skill's SKILL.md (description and/or instructions; omitted fields unchanged). Errors if the skill does not exist.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional. New description (third person). Truncated to 1024 characters. Omit to leave the current description unchanged.

parameters.name: instructions
parameters.description: Optional. New markdown body for SKILL.md. Omit to leave current instructions unchanged.

tools.name: edit_skill_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a supporting file under an existing skill. Errors if the skill does not exist. Creates parent directories as needed.

parameters.name: relative_path
parameters.description: Relative path within the skill (e.g. 'scripts/helper.py' or 'references/api.md').

tools.name: remove_skill
tools.description: Delete an agent skill directory (SKILL.md and all supporting files) by skill name.
